observed-bug: Observed upstream behavior defect:
feat: check sequence expressions in `for-direction` (#20701)

* fix: detect wrong direction in  or-direction when update uses SequenceExpression

* fix: detect wrong direction in  or-direction when update uses SequenceExpression

* fix: skip report when counter appears in multiple sequence expressions

When a SequenceExpression update has the counter modified in more than one sub-expression, treat direction as unknown and skip. Only report when exactly one expression in the sequence modifies the counter in the wrong direction.

* fix: perfectly handle nested SequenceExpressions and unknown assignment RHS in for-direction

* chore
